liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Me and My Uncle** (2 reviews): Described as a primal version of the song; Marks the birth of Cowboy Bob singing it; Bob's vocals sound rough here [8][14]
- **Viola Lee Blues** (2 reviews): Reviewer's earlier source had this spliced; unsure whether this copy is also cut; This version is cut in the middle [8][10]
- **Sick and Tired** (1 review): The same version from mid-set is pasted at the start, slightly slower than the Avalon original [11]
- **Mindbender** (1 review): One of only two live performances of this original, which is also on the 1965 demo [14]
- **It Hurts Me Too** (1 review): Arrangement is looser than the 12-1-66 version, indicating the first set is from another date [15]
- **Lindy** (1 review): One of only three performances of Lindy; Standing on the Corner is also among three [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Sick and Tired**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [18]
- **Standing on the Corner**: rare: 6 archived performances [18]
- **Mindbender**: rare: 4 archived performances [18]
- **Cream Puff War**: rare: 12 archived performances [18]
- **Stealin'**: rare: 14 archived performances [18]
- **Big Boy Pete**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 11 archived performances [18]
- **See That My Grave Is Kept Clean**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **Early Morning Rain**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [18]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Me and My Uncle [18]

## The recordings

- **gd66-11-29.sbd.ret.20448.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 102 min; rated 3.55/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording middling, noting better-sounding copies of this show exist; Sound is hollow, like a tin can, worse than most other 1966 shows; This copy has distortion and multi-generation problems absent from the Avalon source [9][10][11]
- **gd1966-11-29.152152.sbd.hance.sirmick.flac24**: soundboard; 14 songs; 80 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1966-11-29.sbd.graham-perlstein.106497.flac16**: soundboard; 14 songs; 80 min; rated 3.43/5 by 7 [4]
- **gd1966-11-29.sbd.thecore.4940.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 71 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Distant and thin, lacking low end, with low vocal mix; master possibly impaired by worn recorder heads [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the listed first set actually comes from 5/19/66; Deadlists has theories and notes plenty of stage banter [8]
- Agrees that the setlist through Me and My Uncle actually comes from May 19, 1966 [9]
- First eight songs reportedly come from another date [10]
- Tracks 1-8 come from 5/19/66 and have degraded sound quality [13]
- Reviewer recalls sneaking into the city overnight in a '53 Cadillac, crossing the Bay Bridge [16]
- Setlist courtesy of deadlists.com; tuning follows I Just Want To Make Love, with Jerry Pond listed as other artist [2]
- The 12-1-66 It Hurts Me Too is much tighter and more practiced than the one on this tape [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd66-11-29.sbd.ret.20448.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by ret; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard of unknown lineage; the previous seed (shnid 4940) with missing tracks added [1]
- **gd1966-11-29.152152.sbd.hance.sirmick.flac24**: taped by This is Mark Cohen’s tape (Judy Lee’s brother) who worked for Electra records. It was given to Mark by Hail Milgraham, who was a colleague at Electra.; transferred by John Hance and SIRMick; source: Soundboard * [2]
- **gd1966-11-29.sbd.graham-perlstein.106497.flac16**: source: SBD MR>?>Bill Graham Archive>Reel [4]. Also: Seems the same source as the higher-generation circulating copy, but from a lower-generation reel [4]
- **gd1966-11-29.sbd.thecore.4940.shnf**: transferred by thecore; source: SBD from bootleg CD>EAC>SHN [5]. Also: Source is a bootleg CD, so lineage is unknown; the first set is missing [5]
